known_issues: Success Criteria module/tab labels are overlapping/overwriting each other (layout issue).

existing_features.title: Create a responsive, single-page website that presents the candidate’s interview narrative with these sections: (1) Executive Pitch, (2) About Me, (3) Four Success Criteria, (4) Impact (Before vs After), (5) 90‑Day Roadmap.

Implement a hero/landing section (“Executive Pitch”) that shows a crisp professional pitch statement and positions the candidate as a problem solver with high impact; include interviewer names (“Sanjeev” and “Martin”) in a subtle, professional way (e.g., “Tailored for Sanjeev & Martin”).

Add an “About Me” section/page that summarizes the candidate’s 7 years PMO tenure and explicitly aligns to the stated success criteria: transparent & reliable data, governance/process adherence, reduced bottlenecks, improved reporting/automation.

Create an interactive “Success Criteria” module with 6 buttons/tabs: four success criteria buttons, a 5th button labeled “Impact”, and a 6th button labeled “90‑Day Roadmap Plan”. Each of the four success criteria buttons must expand to show exactly 3 detailed stories in STAR format based on the user-provided achievements.
Implement the “Impact” view to show before/after results statements summarizing the 12 activities in a systematic, highly visual way (e.g., two-column “Before vs After” cards).

Implement the “90‑Day Roadmap Plan” view that clearly breaks down Days 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 with concrete, PMO-relevant actions focused on lifecycle integrity, governance control points, automation/validation, dashboards, and enablement/training.

Use the two uploaded images as reference material and include them on the website in a dedicated “Reference”/“Notes” collapsible section (or modal) without extracting or claiming personal identity details; the section should be optional to view and not dominate the primary narrative.

Establish a coherent, visually appealing design theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component style) that communicates “executive governance / operational excellence”. Do not use a blue+purple palette by default.
Remove the hero-section interviewer badge/label text that says “Tailored for Sanjeev & Martin” so it no longer appears anywhere in the UI.

Replace the site’s orange/amber accent styling with a more professional, non-orange accent color and apply it consistently wherever orange/amber gradients, borders, or highlight text are currently used (e.g., hero headline gradient, primary CTA button gradient, stat highlight colors, and any similar accents across sections).

Improve the single-page site’s mobile viewing experience across all sections (Nav, Hero, About Me, Success Criteria tabs, Impact, Roadmap, and Reference Notes) so content is readable, well-spaced, and touch-friendly on small screens without horizontal scrolling or layout overflow.

Generate a new professional, project-management-themed wallpaper image for the homepage hero background, with a clean corporate aesthetic (e.g., subtle Gantt/chart motifs, planning boards, timelines, governance dashboards) and no readable text or logos.

Update the HeroExecutivePitch section to use the newly generated PMO wallpaper as its background image and ensure the existing overlay keeps headline/CTA text highly readable in both light and dark modes.

Add a new "Reviews" section to the single-page site that highlights that stakeholder recommendations are available and provides a prominent external link to the user’s LinkedIn Recommendations page (https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhikajisawant/details/recommendations/?detailScreenTabIndex=0).
Add a "Reviews" navigation entry and an in-page button so users can easily reach the new Reviews section from the sticky nav and from the hero area.
Within the Reviews section, display the LinkedIn Recommendations URL in a copyable format so the user can share the link directly with stakeholders.

Remove the project-management wallpaper image from the Hero (Executive Pitch) section by eliminating the hero background-image styling and ensuring the hero uses a non-image background (e.g., theme background/gradient) while preserving readability of the headline, pitch text, and CTA buttons in both light and dark modes.
Remove any now-unused generated wallpaper static asset(s) from the frontend public assets folder and any code references so the wallpaper is not shipped with the build.

Fix the Success Criteria module tab/button layout so the labels and icons do not overlap/overwrite each other at any viewport size (especially mobile), including the four criteria tabs plus the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” tabs.

Add clear hover, focus, and selected (active) visual states for all tab buttons in the Success Criteria module (the four success criteria tabs plus the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” buttons), so users can visually tell what is interactive, what is hovered, and what is selected.

Ensure the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” controls in the Success Criteria module are clearly separated as two distinct buttons (not visually merged/overwritten) and that each triggers only its respective scroll target (Impact scrolls to the Impact section; 90-Day Plan scrolls to the Roadmap section).
